The landscape report compares bounded reference-generation options and their
operational constraints. It informs which generator or review path is feasible;
it is not itself a ranking experiment.

## Why this matters for 2026

Response-derived evidence depends on the quality and custody of its reference
inputs.

## What this does not prove

Provider specifications and planning estimates are not organizer judgments.
See the
[`dated landscape report`](../../../reports/trec_2026_reference_model_landscape_2026-07-21.md).
